rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both respond to a congressional investigative demand by first acknowledging a desire to cooperate, then explaining why compliance would harm executive functions or the public interest, invoking the constitutional authority and responsibility of the Executive, and finally directing specified executive officials not to comply. The child adapts that same machinery from subpoenas for confidential loyalty files to an exceptionally broad request for Justice Department referral information. C19 is a related precursor concerning congressional access to loyalty files, but it is less directly parallel because it emphasizes confidentiality and arranges an alternative review rather than culminating in the same general instruction to agency heads. C24 concerns cooperation with a House Judiciary subcommittee but points agencies toward compliance and lacks the refusal machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I want to make it clear that I have no wish to obstruct your subcommittee in any legitimate inquiry it may wish to make.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As I have already informed you, I wish to cooperate with your Subcommittee in every reasonable way
shared_material.explanation: Both use a cooperation disclaimer before refusing the congressional demand.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I do not believe such a procedure to be compatible with those provisions of the Constitution which vest the executive power in the President and impose upon him the duty to see that the laws are faithfully executed.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Attorney General ... discussed the Constitutional precedents which support without any question my authority to take the position I have in this matter. The authority of the President in this regard has been recognized since the beginnings of our Government.
shared_material.explanation: Both ground noncompliance in presidential constitutional authority and responsibility against legislative demands.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am advising the departments and agencies that they should not undertake to comply with this particular request.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have felt obliged, therefore, to direct the Secretary of State, the Attorney General and the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission not to comply with your subpoenas.
shared_material.explanation: This is the same central operative mechanism: the President instructs executive officials not to comply with a congressional investigative demand.
